configurations.//: Ports are fixed on purpose. Browser storage is per origin, so a rotating port starts every restart from empty storage and drops the signed-in Supabase session; the /auth/callback OAuth redirect is also registered per origin. Never set autoPort here.
configurations.name: erp-web

configurations.//: Storefront preview from the RELEASE bundle via the single preview owner (scripts/dev/web_preview.sh). One compiled file that boots in seconds; missing assets 404 so readiness checks cannot false-pass. Rebuild after code changes: bash scripts/dev/web_preview.sh build --store --release. Debug/DWDS: bash scripts/dev/web_preview.sh start --store (stop this first, same port).
configurations.name: erp-store
